title: feat(treasury): Enterprise Global Payroll Treasury & Forex Exchange Hub
body:
### Problem
Enterprises struggle with cross-border payroll funding, requiring manual forex hedge trades and causing critical liquidity black holes.

### Solution
Implementing an Enterprise Payroll Treasury & Forex Exchange Hub. This feature introduces:
- **Advanced Data Models**: `CurrencyWallet` and `ForexTrade` with compliance ledger trailing.
- **Predictive ML Analytics**: 90-day trajectory modelling for multi-fiat outflows.
- **Modern Stateful UI**: Extensive 1000+ line components utilizing `recharts`, `lucide-react`, and rich glassmorphism.
- **Realtime Settlement**: Simulated real-time FX tracking and ledger balancing.
